entries.topic: Career totals, current Congress (Track AIPAC, 5 July 2026)

claims.text: Senate Democrats, career totals to 5 July 2026: Adam Schiff $5,609,345 ($5,027,750 outside spending, 2024 Senate race), Jacky Rosen $2,264,274, Jon Ossoff $954,187, Raphael Warnock $858,927, Cory Booker $851,721; top 25 total $22,130,393; Bernie Sanders, Chris Van Hollen, Jeff Merkley and Peter Welch listed at $0.

Senate Republicans: Susan Collins $4,131,569 ($3,566,569 direct), Ted Cruz $1,411,545, Tom Cotton $1,127,943, John Cornyn $1,079,549, Mitch McConnell $992,646; top 25 total $18,938,633; Rand Paul $2,000.

House Democrats: Haley Stevens $36,280,260 ($34,913,946 outside), George Latimer $19,182,192 ($16,200,140 outside), Wesley Bell $18,126,578 ($13,730,045 outside), Glenn Ivey $7,320,411, Shontel Brown $5,090,445; top 25 total $128,751,587; Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, Summer Lee, Pramila Jayapal, Greg Casar and Ayanna Pressley listed at $0; Hakeem Jeffries $1,495,709 (all direct).

House Republicans: Mark Messmer $2,852,335 ($2,522,844 outside), Don Bacon $1,291,908, Juan Ciscomani $1,224,703, Mike Lawler $1,181,950, Speaker Mike Johnson $1,134,227; top 25 total $21,813,211; Thomas Massie $0.
Track AIPAC is an advocacy group; its totals count all pro-Israel PACs including J Street, plus their large donors, plus outside spending on a member's behalf.
